instruction: Draft the Notice Inviting Tender (NIT) header for: Procurement of Two 14-17 T Mobile Hydraulic Cranes with Front Mounted Cabin for NRL. Use two-part GeM bidding. Mark E-File ref PUR-MECHMNT-1009380.
tender_context: Organization: NUMALIGARH REFINERY LIMITED (A Govt. of India Enterprise).
NRL invites online bids through GeM Portal in two-part bid (Part-I: Techno-Commercial part & Part-II: Priced part) from eligible bidders as per the Scope of supply mentioned in the tender document.
Corrigendum / addendum (if any) shall be published in GeM Portal Only.
Job Name: Procurement of Two 14-17 T Mobile Hydraulic Cranes with Front Mounted Cabin for NRL.
Commercial contact: Praveen Lal, Assistant Officer (Commercial), Email: praveen.lal@nrl.co.in.
Technical contact: Dikhita Lahon, Sr. Officer (Mech. Maintenance), Email: Dikhita.lahon@nrl.co.in.
Required footer: Prepared & issued by NUMALIGARH REFINERY LIMITED (A Govt. of India Enterprise).
